annotations.title: Check talent pool depth for a role

description: Check how well Armasourcing's candidate pool covers a specific brief. Returns match depth as a band, typical experience, and the skills and tools that show up most often. Deliberately returns NO individual candidates: no names, no profiles, no contact details. Use it to answer 'do you have people who can do X' honestly before recommending a call.

role.description: Role or job title, e.g. 'executive assistant', 'bookkeeper', 'SEO specialist'.

skills.description: Specific skills or tools the role needs, e.g. ['QuickBooks', 'Xero'] or ['Shopify', 'Klaviyo'].

timezone_overlap.description: Business hours the person needs to cover, e.g. '9-5 EST'. Optional.

name: search_talent_pool
